topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I don't even know where to start. I was just there, at the gate, listening to them drone on about delays and weather, and all I could think was, "How is this possible?" My heart's racing, and I can't get the image of everyone there, without me, out of my head. What am I supposed to do now? They say there's another flight, but it's hours from now, and I can't miss this, I just can't. I'm stuck here, in this airport, feeling so small and helpless. I need to figure something out, fast, but the more I think, the more tangled everything gets. If you can think of anything, anything at all, I'm all ears. I really need you right now.
